learning_outcomes.text: Explain energy-management principles and the ISO 50001 cycle
Collect and analyse energy data to build a baseline and KPIs
Evaluate projects using savings, payback and simple financials
Sustain savings through monitoring, targeting and behaviour

integrative_case: A site manager is told to cut energy cost by 15%. Build a normalised baseline and EnPIs, run a walk-through audit to populate an opportunity register, evaluate the shortlist on savings and payback, and set up monitoring and targeting so the savings persist rather than drifting back.
